name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While specific returns can vary, a tub-to-shower conversion generally contributes positively to your home's value, especially if it updates an outdated bathroom or improves accessibility. Modernizing a bathroom is often a strong selling point for potential buyers. If your home has multiple bathrooms, converting one tub to a shower can appeal to a broader range of buyers looking for both a tub and a dedicated shower. It's considered a valuable update by many real estate professionals.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion can increase home value by modernizing the bathroom and improving accessibility, appealing to more potential buyers.
